about: The calibration arena (tools/tasim/calibref.py, arena()). map: a multiplayer map of the base game; scenario: its launch and first empty point. los and mapping: the default of every calibration scenario, the skirmish's True line of sight and Mapped, which a reference is keyed by. flat: the largest dry rectangle of one height on the map, [x, y, width, height] in world units, found offline from its TNT heights (height 73, sea level 20) and checked live by every duel's apply (each unit's actual altitude equal). a, b, axis: a duel puts side A at a and side B along the axis toward b at its distance. courses: a movement course per land move class, [from, to]. meteor_free: the map's .ota names no MeteorWeapon, which calib.py checks against the install.
